## About me

I am an economics graduate from University of Hyderabad (MA in Economics). Currently, I am working as an Consultant in Development of Monitoring and Evaluation Office(DMEO), NITI Aayog. 

I enjoy identifying the interdependence and interconnections between policy initiatives and social realities through data. I like translating data points into stories that reflect real-world impacts across diverse experiences.
